admission.justification: The retained merge and the hook-classification routes share this check, and the tests distinguish carried input from newly authored faults.

applicability: Staged checks for a retained code or memory sync merge and an automatically settled memory merge.
conditions: The active merge retains the verified task and incoming parents.
Git reports the same path, staged line and diagnosis against both parents for an attributable finding.
exclusions: Pre-commit Git comparison failures and diagnostics without a unique path are reported separately.
Checks with one parent keep their ordinary HEAD comparison.

evidence: W2 clean-copy sync regression command and base/candidate results.
handoff.path: L26 W3 invariant and onboarding judgments

statement: Sync reports staged whitespace and conflict-marker findings only where both verified merge parents report the same finding.
